description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Poxwalkers and Squee, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Poxwalkers triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
